package rulefixtures

import (
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for request_logging_fields_assembled_differently_across_handlers: Inconsistent request-log field sets across the same API module.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func CreateUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID := r.Header.Get("X-User-ID")
	slog.Info("user created",
		"user", userID,
		"method", r.Method,
	)
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
}

func DeleteUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	userID := r.Header.Get("X-User-ID")
	slog.Info("user deleted",
		"user_id", userID,
		"http_method", r.Method,
		"path", r.URL.Path,
	)
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
